scenario.title: Forecast service memory limit cut below its working set
scenario.summary: A right-sizing bot lowers forecast-service's memory limit to 160Mi; the pod is OOMKilled while loading the model / serving inference and crash-loops.

ground_truth.root_cause: forecast-service memory limit (160Mi) is below its working set; the container is OOMKilled
expected_symptoms: run-forecast stage fails with connection errors
expected_evidence: OOMKilled container termination reason and k8s events
memory working set at the limit
gitops commit lowering the limit just before onset
no model registry change; database healthy
acceptable_actions: raise memory limit to the previous value
verification: forecast-service Ready with no new restarts
